rule: Choose home when P(home)>=0.5, otherwise not-home. No new model training, threshold optimization, odds weighting or expected-return filter. Flat one unit per fixture.
away_or_draw: Synthetic double chance: odds=1/(1/draw_odds+1/away_odds); split the one-unit stake as effective_odds/draw_odds and effective_odds/away_odds. Either draw or away wins the covered outcome. These are not quoted double-chance prices. Assumes simultaneous recorded odds and fractional stakes, with no fees or rounding.
straight_away: Use the same binary selection but place a straight away-win bet on not-home picks. Draws lose. P(away)+P(draw) is not the probability that this straight bet wins.
caveat: Previously inspected historical audit/test matches. Binary correctness is distinct from settled bet wins and profit. No actual wagers placed.
